priorityList: Always start the fight with Shadowstrike to apply Deathstalker's Mark.
Cast Shadow Dance when you have 2 or fewer combo points and Secret Technique is ready or Shadow Blades is active.
Cast Shadow Blades during Shadow Dance.
Cast Secret Technique during Shadow Dance with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Eviscerate with 6 or more combo points when Darkest Night is active.
Cast Black Powder with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Goremaw's Bite when you are not in Shadow Dance.
On exactly 2 targets, build combo points with Shadowstrike over Shuriken Storm whenever available.
Cast Shuriken Storm to build combo points.
Do not cast Shadow Dance if Shadow Blades has less than 10 seconds left on its cooldown.
Maintain Slice and Dice (ideally through Premeditation or Invidious Venom).
Cast Symbols of Death on cooldown, ideally paired with Shadow Dance.
Cast Shadow Dance when you have at least 1 charge available and Symbols of Death is active.
Cast Shuriken Storm as your primary Combo Point builder when 2 or more targets are present.
Cast Secret Technique at 6 or more Combo Points, prioritizing its use during Shadow Dance.
Cast Black Powder as your primary finisher at 6 or more Combo Points.
Cast Shuriken Tornado during large pulls to maximize Combo Point generation.
Apply Rupture to at least one target to trigger energy regeneration from Venomous Shadows.
Use Cold Blood in conjunction with Secret Technique for maximum burst damage.
Ensure Deathstalker's Mark is applied to your primary target via Shadowstrike or Ambush.
